title: SSE stream raises unhandled exception if pane is killed mid-stream
description: Lines 277-290: `_stream_pane_output` resolves the pane once (line 279) then loops with `while True`. If the pane is killed during streaming, `pane.capture_pane()` (line 282) raises an exception that propagates up unhandled. Result: client sees an abrupt connection drop instead of a clean SSE termination event. The generator should catch pane-not-found and yield a final `{"type": "closed"}` event before returning.
